name: a_second_signature_from_the_same_business_is_refused_as_a_duplicate
distinguishing_aspect:
The uniqueness rule is scoped to VALID signatures of one (petition_drive_id,
lodging_business_id) pair, and the refusal must leave the drive's tallies untouched — no
second 60,000,000 is added to signed_basis_cents and weighted_support_pct stays 0.6000
rather than climbing to 1.2000.

setup: canonical district PROPOSED with the four-property roll
FORMATION drive OPEN in [2026-08-01, 2026-09-01), b1 has signed once
assert: the response status is 409 with data.error_id == ERR_DUPLICATE_SIGNATURE
PetitionDrive.${pd_id}.valid_signature_count == 1
PetitionDrive.${pd_id}.signed_basis_cents == 60000000
PetitionDrive.${pd_id}.weighted_support_pct == 0.6000
GET /petition-drives/${pd_id}/signatures returns exactly one row

name: a_withdrawn_dispute_frees_its_type_slot_while_the_other_type_was_never_blocked
distinguishing_aspect:
The uniqueness predicate is keyed on (assessment_statement_id, dispute_type) and counts only
non-terminal rows, so one statement carries two independent slots. The walk proves both halves
of the predicate on the same statement: a second CALCULATION_ERROR dispute is refused while the
first is SUBMITTED, an EXEMPT_PROPERTY dispute on the very same statement is accepted at the
same moment, and once the first dispute is WITHDRAWN — a terminal state — the previously
refused CALCULATION_ERROR request succeeds unchanged. Every accepted dispute is a fresh row
with version 1 and a lodging_business_id copied from the statement rather than from the payload.

setup: one CALCULATION_ERROR dispute on st1 sitting in SUBMITTED (review deliberately not opened, so WITHDRAW stays legal)

payload.dispute_note: resort fee should not sit in the revenue basis
the annex wing is a nonprofit retreat

payload.note: operator will refile with the corrected ledger

assert: the second CALCULATION_ERROR filing returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_DISPUTE_ALREADY_OPEN
the EXEMPT_PROPERTY filing returns 201 even though a CALCULATION_ERROR dispute is open on the same statement, because the slot key includes dispute_type
AssessmentDispute.${dsp_exempt_id}.status == SUBMITTED with version == 1 and lodging_business_id == ${b1_id} and claimed_adjustment_cents == 824500
the withdrawal returns 200 and AssessmentDispute.${dsp1_id}.status == WITHDRAWN
the refiled CALCULATION_ERROR dispute returns 201 and ${dsp1_again_id} != ${dsp1_id}
AssessmentDispute.${dsp1_again_id}.status == SUBMITTED with version == 1, appeal_count == 0 and info_request_count == 0
GET /assessment-disputes?dispute_type=CALCULATION_ERROR returns both the WITHDRAWN ${dsp1_id} and the SUBMITTED ${dsp1_again_id}, so the withdrawn row was retained rather than deleted

AssessmentStatement.${st1_id}.effective_assessment_cents is still 824500 and AssessmentStatement.${st1_id}.payment_status is still UNPAID, because filing or withdrawing a dispute never touches the money

name: statement_filing_priority_ladder_returns_401_403_403_400_then_404
distinguishing_aspect:
One endpoint is hit five times with a request that is simultaneously unauthenticated, wrongly
roled, backed by an unresolvable operator identity, missing a required field and pointed at a
statement id that does not exist. Each call removes exactly one defect, so the observed error
walks the priority ladder 401 -> 403 ERR_FORBIDDEN_ROLE -> 403 ERR_OPERATOR_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN
-> 400 -> 404; an implementation that validates the body first would answer 400 to all five.

setup: canonical district ACTIVE with period FY2027-Q1 generated, st1 belongs to b1

trigger.as: NONE — the X-User-Role and X-User-ID headers are both omitted

assert: call 1 returns 401 with data.error_id == ERR_UNAUTHENTICATED
call 2 returns 403 with data.error_id == ERR_FORBIDDEN_ROLE, because BoardMember is not in this endpoint's roles
call 3 returns 403 with data.error_id == ERR_OPERATOR_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN, decided before the missing field and before the path id
call 4 returns 400 with data.error_id == ERR_INVALID_REQUEST for the missing reported_gross_room_revenue_cents
call 5 returns 404 with data.error_id == ERR_ASSESSMENT_STATEMENT_NOT_FOUND
AssessmentStatement.${st1_id}.filing_status is still NOT_FILED, since none of the five calls touched a real statement

name: a_program_cannot_be_funded_by_a_plan_still_in_board_review
distinguishing_aspect:
The refusal is decided entirely on a different aggregate: the program request is perfectly
well formed and the district is ACTIVE, and only the plan's BOARD_REVIEW status blocks it.
The identical request is accepted once a second board member approves the plan, which proves
the check reads the plan row rather than anything on the program payload.

setup: canonical district ACTIVE, st1 and st2 filed so the plan can clear the funding ratio
plan FY2027 sponsored, standing in BOARD_REVIEW

expenditure_lines.narrative: paid search, trade shows and group sales

payload.note: sponsored for the fiscal 2027 board cycle
approved at the July board meeting

assert: the first program creation returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_WORK_PLAN_NOT_APPROVED
AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_id}.committed_program_cents == 0 after the refusal
GET /annual-work-plans/${wp_id}/marketing-programs returns 0 rows after the refusal
the approval returns 200 and AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_id}.status == APPROVED with funding_ratio 1.1645
the identical program creation then returns 201 with MarketingProgram.${mp_id}.status == PLANNED
AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_id}.committed_program_cents == 62000

name: notice_exactly_fourteen_days_ahead_is_accepted_and_thirteen_is_not
distinguishing_aspect:
Both sides of the 14-whole-day notice boundary are walked from a single pinned clock: with the
clock at 2026-08-01 a record scheduled for 2026-08-15 is exactly 14 days out and must be
noticeable, while one scheduled for 2026-08-14 is 13 days out and must be refused. Only one
of the two records is a PUBLIC_MEETING, so the unrelated 10-day meeting separation rule
cannot interfere with the result.

setup: an ANNUAL_REPORT record scheduled_for 2026-08-15 and a PUBLIC_MEETING record scheduled_for 2026-08-14
assert: the 13-day notice returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_MEETING_NOTICE_TOO_LATE
TransparencyRecord.${rec_meeting_id}.status is still SCHEDULED and noticed_on == null
the 14-day notice returns 200 with TransparencyRecord.${rec_report_id}.status == NOTICED
TransparencyRecord.${rec_report_id}.noticed_on == 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z
District.${d_id}.transparency_standing == COMPLIANT throughout

name: committed_program_spend_may_equal_but_not_exceed_the_marketing_line
distinguishing_aspect:
The ceiling is an aggregate over sibling rows rather than a per-row limit: two programs of
400000 and 250000 are both accepted because their sum is exactly the 650000
SALES_AND_MARKETING line, and a third program of a single cent is then refused. Neither
accepted program is individually near the ceiling, so a per-request check would have let the
third through.

setup: canonical district ACTIVE with st1 and st2 filed, plan FY2027 APPROVED with SALES_AND_MARKETING 650000

expenditure_lines.narrative: paid search, trade shows and group sales

payload.note: sponsored for the fiscal 2027 board cycle
approved at the July board meeting

assert: the 400000 program returns 201 and AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_id}.committed_program_cents == 400000
the 250000 program returns 201 and AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_id}.committed_program_cents == 650000, exactly the marketing line
the 1-cent program returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_PROGRAM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_id}.committed_program_cents is still 650000 after the refusal
GET /annual-work-plans/${wp_id}/marketing-programs returns exactly 2 rows

name: capital_improvement_is_permitted_on_a_pct_district_and_refused_on_a_tiered_one
distinguishing_aspect:
Two plans carrying byte-identical expenditure_lines are approved against two districts that
differ only in assessment_method: the PCT_OF_ROOM_REVENUE district accepts the
CAPITAL_IMPROVEMENT line and reports capital_improvement_cents 200000, while the
TIERED_BY_CLASSIFICATION district refuses the same line. Both plans satisfy every cap, so the
conditional category rule is the only thing separating the two outcomes.

setup: canonical PCT district ACTIVE with st1 and st2 filed, so its plan clears the 0.9000 funding ratio
Summit Ridge district ACTIVE on TIERED_BY_CLASSIFICATION
each district holds a DRAFT FY2027 plan with lines SALES_AND_MARKETING 700000, ADMINISTRATION 100000, CAPITAL_IMPROVEMENT 200000, sponsored by board-member-01

payload.note: sponsored for the fiscal 2027 board cycle
sponsored for the fiscal 2027 board cycle
approved at the Summit Ridge board meeting
approved at the Harbor Bay board meeting

assert: the TIERED_BY_CLASSIFICATION approval returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_NOT_PERMITTED
AnnualWorkPlan.${wp3_ci_id}.status is still BOARD_REVIEW and approver_user_id == null
the PCT_OF_ROOM_REVENUE approval returns 200 with AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_ci_id}.status == APPROVED
AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_ci_id}.capital_improvement_cents == 200000 and total_budget_cents == 1000000
AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_ci_id}.administration_cents == 100000 is under the 150000 cap and sales_and_marketing_cents == 700000 is over the 600000 floor, so no cap decided either outcome
AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_ci_id}.funding_ratio == 1.1645

name: operator_ownership_is_checked_after_existence_so_a_missing_statement_returns_404
distinguishing_aspect:
The ownership check cannot run until existence has resolved the row it would read, so b2
aiming at an id that does not exist gets 404 rather than the 403 an ownership-first
implementation would return, and the same operator aiming at b1's real statement then gets
403. b2's own identity resolves in both calls, so p25 is satisfied and only the p40/p50 order
is under test.

setup: canonical district ACTIVE with period FY2027-Q1 generated; st1 belongs to b1 and b2 is a different assessable property
assert: the first call returns 404 with data.error_id == ERR_ASSESSMENT_STATEMENT_NOT_FOUND
the second call returns 403 with data.error_id == ERR_NOT_RESOURCE_OWNER
AssessmentStatement.${st1_id}.filing_status is still NOT_FILED and provisional_assessment_cents == 0
